title: Calculation function to analyze the metabolite conservation index — calc_conservation_metabolite
text: metabolite conservation index compares metabolite profiles across subjects two time points. metabolite conservation index quantifies conservation (stability) single metabolite comparison measured metabolites. processed data metime_analyzer used calculate metabolite conservation index CI(x) metabolite x $$CI(x)=1-(rank(x)-1)/(N-1)$$, $$rank(x)=N-z z=|{y∈⟦1,N⟧≠x∨ρ_p (M_x^bl,M_x^fu )≥ρ_p (M_x^bl,M_y^fu )}|$$, N number subjects, M_i^bl aggregated metabolite profile across subjects baseline, M_i^fu aggregated metabolite profile subjects follow , ρ_p $$M_i^bl,M_j^fu$$) Pearson correlation coefficient metabolite baseline metabolite j follow $$x,,j∈⟦1,N⟧$$. resulting index ranges 0 1, 0 = conservation 1 = maximal conservation. approach first described Yousri et al. 2014, Long-term conservation human metabolic phenotypes link heritability.
